main_axis.headline: A large body of your own judgment and peers pushes you forward, and almost nothing in the chart pushes back.
main_axis.body: The lead force is Companion — your own judgment, and peers who move with you — with Rob Wealth — competition among peers scrambling for resources — almost as heavy, so the two run together. The only outlet is Output: Eating God, output that flows naturally as craft and enjoyment, plus a little Hurting Officer, the urge to speak out. This chart does not follow the regular framework; the engine withholds favorable-element conclusions, so what follows describes structure and timing only.
main_axis.dominant: Companion, Rob Wealth (Companion family, jointly dominant)
main_axis.latent: none of the Wealth, Officer-Killings, or Resource families carry weight
main_axis.evidence: Companion and Rob Wealth dominate the chart: water count is seven of the eight visible characters — year, month and day stems are all Gui water, the hour stem is Ren water, and the month, day and hour branches (Hai, Hai, Zi) are water branches; the year branch Ro is the only wood branch. Ten God weights: Companion thirteen and Rob Wealth eleven, counting the hidden stems of Hai (Ren as Rob Wealth) and Zi (Gui as Companion); Eating God three from the hidden Yi in the year branch Ro; Hurting Officer two from hidden Jia in the month and day branches. Wealth, Officer-Killings and Resource all weigh zero, and fire, earth and metal count zero among the visible characters.

core_loop.headline: Self-replication: your own way of judging → more peers and competitors confirming it → an even firmer way of judging.
core_loop.flow: You decide by your own reading of a situation, and the people around you — many of them competitors for the same room — mirror that reading back, so it hardens into conviction. The outlet exists but is small: craft and enjoyment carry only a fraction of the water's volume, so most of the energy circulates among the group rather than leaving it as finished work.
core_loop.driver: Day Master Gui water runs a follow-the-strong configuration: seven water among the visible characters, month and day branches both at imperial-prosperity grade for water; the engine withholds favorable-element conclusions for this configuration. Companion family weighs twenty-four versus Output five; Wealth, Officer-Killings and Resource all zero.
core_loop.leak:
The cost is that the chart supplies no counterweight: with nothing that banks results, enforces rules, or demands proof from outside, you can circulate with capable people for years and still hold little that an outsider can point to.
In the ten years starting around age 49 (the 戊午 pillar) and the ten years starting around age 59 (the 丁巳 pillar), earth and fire run stronger than at any earlier stretch, which is the first sustained contact with structure and demands this configuration meets.
Meanwhile, treat every peer exchange as one that must end in a deliverable — a written thing, a sold thing, a signed thing — before the next round begins.
core_loop.evidence: Age-49 stretch: (戊 pillar, Wu earth stem over Wu fire branch) and age-59 stretch: (丁 pillar, Ding fire stem over Si fire branch) exist in the luck sequence, the first pillars carrying earth and fire; before them the age-9 (壬戌), age-19 (辛酉) and age-29 (庚申) pillars add more water and metal to an already water-heavy chart. Fire, earth and metal count zero in the natal characters; the Ro wood branch is the sole visible non-water character.

structure_type.name: the one-current stream type
structure_type.one_line: Everything in you runs one way with great volume, and you gain by going with that current — moving in company, judging fast — rather than by adding friction from outside.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when the room itself is the resource and speed of judgment decides; weakest when you must show a finished, bankable result to a stranger.
capability_source.text: Your strength comes from mass and speed: when a group needs someone to read the situation first and commit first — say, a night shift where the plan collapses and you call the replacement route while others are still phoning for instructions — the same judgment that fills the chart carries the room. That judgment is the chart's own element at full tide, so it costs you little to keep producing it.
capability_source.evidence: Day Master Gui water sits on a water branch at imperial-prosperity grade, with the month branch also water at the same grade and the hour branch Zi water at the approach-to-officer grade; Companion thirteen and Rob Wealth eleven supply the judging-and-peers mass, while Eating God three and Hurting Officer two mark the only channel that turns judgment into visible work.

structure_fingerprint: Runs one water current at full volume: judges fast among peers, ships little to outsiders until a deliverable is forced.
